summary: A Scanner reads what the user types. Use nextLine() for text and nextInt() or nextDouble() for numbers.
notes: import java.util.Scanner; must be at the top of the file.
nextInt() returns an int, so you can do math with it right away.
pitfall: Calling nextLine() right after nextInt() returns an empty String, because nextInt() leaves the Enter key in the input. Call an extra nextLine() first.
